notes.title: Minor Fixes
notes.content:
While we have a bigger update planned for later in the year, this update we wanted out before that.  It adds some better direction to encounters, fixes some minor bugs and tweaks a couple of abilities for balance.

The big thing however is the addition of controller support!  While Doomed Star's was designed to use a mouse and keyboard, we want to do what we can to make it playable with your preferred control system.

This implementation is a little quick and dirty so we will probably tweak it a bit more for the big update later this year, but for now we hope it works!

Oh!  We also added some new achievements!
